name: red-hat-blonde-cowgirl-confidence
image_vibe: Playful confident retro western styling with red hat, blonde braids, and bright studio polish
image_purpose: Create a cosplay-inspired fashion portrait for editorial lookbook or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A clean bright waist-up fashion portrait of an original adult woman in a western-inspired cowgirl look.
prompt.main_subject: The adult woman from the required approved-adult reference, preserving her face, facial structure, eye characteristics, and natural skin tone. She has blonde hair in two long braids with a center part and face-framing strands. She wears a white strapless bandeau crop top with a yellow chest band, red piping, a silver circular buckle, yellow armbands with red ribbon details, high-waisted denim shorts with white side panels and a chaps-style front cutout, a brown leather belt with an ornate gold buckle, a red wide-brim cowgirl hat with white stitching, small gold hoops, and holds a clear wine glass with white wine.
prompt.composition_elements: Waist-up centered portrait with the subject slightly turned toward camera, one hand on hip and the other holding the wine glass, red hat centered and slightly tilted, plain off-white wall, balanced negative space, and sharp face and outfit detail.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal studio lighting with minimal shadows, warm natural tone, clean bright retro-western fashion mood, and controlled highlights on the hat stitching, buckle, jewelry, and glass.
prompt.technical_specs: Eye-level 50mm lens, shallow background blur, waist-up centered framing, photorealistic fashion photography, realistic skin, denim, leather, metal, glass, hair, and stitching texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic waist-up fashion portrait of the adult woman from the required approved-adult reference, preserving her face, facial structure, eye characteristics, and natural skin tone. Give her blonde hair in two long braids with a center part and face-framing strands. Dress her in a white strapless bandeau crop top with a yellow chest band, red piping, a silver circular buckle, yellow armbands with red ribbon details, high-waisted denim shorts with white side panels and a chaps-style front cutout, a brown leather belt with an ornate gold buckle, and a red wide-brim cowgirl hat with white stitching. Add small gold hoops and a clear wine glass with white wine. Pose her slightly turned toward camera with one hand on her hip and the other holding the glass.
